podcast-joerogan-4wjK71VS8T4:
Could AI be turned into a tool of propaganda? A segment of the Joe Rogan Experience takes up that fear, as Rogan thinks through what smart machines could do to public debate. The worry is not robots with guns, but software that writes, targets, and repeats a message endlessly.

Rogan weighs fake accounts, tailored news feeds, and videos that look real but are not. The talk asks who would aim such tools, and whether voters could ever spot the trick. It is an early, worried look at a problem that has only grown since, recorded in the show's open, unscripted style.
podcast-tuckercarlson-ocCc0Xua9T4:
Comic and commentator Dave Smith joins Tucker Carlson for a dissident briefing on Mossad, World War II myths, and FBI cover-ups. Smith, a libertarian and host of Part of the Problem, is known for attacking sacred cows on war and state power. Nothing gets spared here either.

Smith gives his case on Israel's intelligence reach and on stories from the war that he says were oversold. He and Carlson discuss what the FBI has hidden in past scandals. The talk ends on Trump's critical next move in Iran, as Smith sees it. Questioning and bold viewers get uncomfortable truths argued at full strength.
